results.evidence: New test test_a_write_that_fails_partway_leaves_no_file_and_no_record monkeypatches Path.write_bytes to write half the bytes into OUT then raise OSError; it asserts exit code 1, no file named after the draft in OUT, OUT is entirely empty, and zero prepared activities (env.prepared() == 0). The test ran with the other 3 tests in the file: 4 passed. send.py now writes via _write_atomically (temp file, os.replace, removed on failure), so the partial bytes never appear under the draft name. I did not mutate the code to confirm the test fails without the fix.
results.quote:
monkeypatch.setattr(Path, "write_bytes", write_half_then_fail)
    code = env.prepare()
    monkeypatch.undo()
    assert code == 1
    assert not (env.out / env.draft.name).exists()
    assert list(env.out.iterdir()) == []
    assert env.prepared() == 0
